title: An approval answered in Telegram or the app clears the other
goal: Answering an approval in either place withdraws or marks it answered in the other
acceptance: An approval answered in Telegram shows answered in the app and the reverse
A late answer in the other channel is refused as already answered, not applied twice
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens, endpoints or personal data in Git.
validation: Every test reading live.js, dashboard.js or web/src
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: answered state read in both channels plus a double-answer guard. Not a measurement.
